payload.text: ST0091/02, kovacs runs the cut's gates as its leg and prepush keeps only its push gates, dc's; vc judges it and claims nothing. Banked at refs/bank/dc/st0091/wp02-v1 (blob 47b34ed12de4, patch-id dc4a58b8c07b), a diff from the tree of wp01a-v2 and wp01b-v1 (159550239aa1). release.legs names kovacs; preflight-linux.sh and preflight.lib are gone; prepush no longer clones, builds or asks for a Linux preflight, and asks no currency verdict of a push that moves only candidate refs, the prefix read from release.publish.candidate (vc's F2 ruling). The test files it touches pass; prepush_push_range.bats's reds on the tree before it are arms 1, 3, 4, 5 and 8, and arms 2, 6 and 7 hold what did not change. A candidate push and a main push were driven through the real hook on a scratch clone: the first passes with no pair, the second is refused. AT-02.1 and AT-02.2 cite prepush_push_range.bats, which is on main, so they are minted at the landing with AT-01.4. intent/docs/releasing.md still describes the Linux preflight: that is WP-04's docs part.
